# Latvia — 2017

> Benchmark chips for Latvia cut from the 2017 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection lv.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/lv_2017_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/lv_2017_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/lv_2017_fields.parquet)
- [Field polygons after the class filter](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/lv_2017_fields_filtered.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lv_2017/items.parquet)
